}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "S SiPEED", "LM3A" and "SiPEED Lichee Module 3A" are silkscreened on module top.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[SpacemiT]] ''Key Stone'' K1 (X60) @1.6GHz :SoC: Octa-Core RISC-V (RV64GC) 64-bit :NPU: 2.0 TOPS (AI from RlSC-V Core) *GPU: ''Imagination'' BXE-2-32 @819MHz :32KB SLC (OpenGL ES3.2) :VPU: H.264/H.265 decoder up to 4Kp60, :H.265 encoder up to 4Kp30 *Storage: 32GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash (''[[Rayson]]'') *Memory: 8GB (LPDDR4X) SDRAM (''[[Biwin]]'') *Network: 2x GbE ports *Power Source: 5V/2A via SODIMM Connector
